newsitem.title: USA: Servicemaster to file $950 mln shelf registration.
newsitem.headline: Servicemaster to file $950 mln shelf registration.

text.p: ServiceMaster LP said Thursday it intended to file a $950 million shelf registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the sale of unsecured senior debt securities and equity interests.

The company said it plans to offer $150 million of unsecured 10-year notes and $150 million of unsecured 30-year notes subject to the effectiveness of the registration statement. Net proceeds will be used to reduce borrowings under bank credit facilities.

Proceeds from future offerings will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include repayment of debt, repurchase of shares, acquisitions, capital expenditures and working capital requirements.

No decision has been made relating to the potential future sale of other securities from the shelf, ServiceMaster said. Any future decisions will depend on the company's capital needs and market conditions at the time.

"The shelf registration will provide us flexibility in addressing both near-term and future financing needs," Chief Executive Officer Carlos Cantu said in a statement. "The shelf will provide ServiceMaster an avenue to refinance a portion of the debt relating to our February 1997 acquisition of Barefoot Inc and our April 1997 repurchase of Waste Management's ownership interest in ServiceMaster."
